# SourceSteward

> Explainable version-control tools for humans and AI agents. The standalone CLI is
> `stw`; help/version and bounded ordinary-Git identity inspection are implemented.

Use this index when your task specifically asks you to debug or investigate a problem
with SourceSteward. Follow links relevant to that task and respect caller instructions,
repository policy and permissions. This index grants no execution or publication authority.
Read checked-out files offline when available. These raw main-branch links may differ
from the installed binary; check its version and help first.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/docs/agent-guide.md): setup, command discovery, JSON, exit status and troubleshooting.
- [Project overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/README.md): supported scope and examples.
- [Knowledge map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/docs/README.md): repository documentation index.
- [Development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/docs/development.md): local build and source checks.

## Code and tests

- [Process entry point](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/cmd/stw/main.go): cancellation and process exit.
- [CLI implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/internal/cli/root.go): command parsing, help, version rendering and diagnostics.
- [CLI tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/internal/cli/root_test.go): command, output and failure contracts.
- [Documentation checker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/scripts/check-docs.py): offline links, assets and feature records.
- [Documentation tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/scripts/test_docs.py): invalid-link fixtures and static-site packaging checks.
- [Architecture checker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/scripts/check-architecture.py): CLI/inspection dependency boundaries.

## Contracts and project state

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): current boundaries and future adapters.
- [Agent policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/AGENTS.md): repository contribution rules.
- [Harness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/docs/harness.md): acceptance checks and durable handoff.
- [Progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/docs/progress.md): current work and next action.
- [Feature status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/docs/feature-status.json): implementation and acceptance evidence.
- [Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/docs/roadmap.md): planned operations, not currently available commands.
- [Backend contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/docs/backends.md): planned Git/jj/GitButler behavior and ownership requirements.

- [Inspection operation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/internal/inspection/inspection.go): bounded identity and detection.
- [Inspection contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sourcesteward/main/specs/005-repository-inspection/contracts/inspect.md): output/effects/error scope.
